words.enDefinition: An online location where people can store, organize, and open files.

examples.en: I uploaded the field notes to our cloud drive after getting back to campus.
examples.zh: 回学校后，我把实地考察笔记上传到了我们的「云盘」。

examples.en: My roommate checked her cloud drive for the presentation she had left open at home.
examples.zh: 室友去「云盘」里找她在家时还开着的那份演示文稿。

collocations: save a file to a cloud drive

words.enDefinition: A folder stored in an online file service.

examples.en: We used a cloud folder to collect the photographs for our group's final presentation.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「云端文件夹」收集小组期末展示要用的照片。

examples.en: My classmate renamed the cloud folder after we decided on a new project title.
examples.zh: 我们确定新的项目名称后，同学给「云端文件夹」改了名。

words.enDefinition: An online space where a group can access materials and work on a project together.

examples.en: Our seminar group kept its research notes in a shared workspace for the term.
examples.zh: 整个学期，我们研讨小组都把研究笔记放在一个「共享工作空间」里。

examples.en: The shared workspace had separate sections for the schedule, meeting notes, and reading list.
examples.zh: 「共享工作空间」把日程、会议笔记和阅读清单分在不同栏目里。

collocations: add materials to a shared workspace

words.enDefinition: A link used to open a file or folder that someone has shared.

examples.en: I opened the sharing link from my classmate to read the group's latest draft.
examples.zh: 我打开同学发来的「共享链接」，看了小组最新的草稿。

examples.en: The tutor posted a sharing link beside the notes for our seminar on Monday.
examples.zh: 导师把一个「共享链接」发在星期一研讨课的笔记旁边。

words.enDefinition: Settings that control how a file's sharing link works.

examples.en: We checked the link settings before sending the project draft to our seminar group.
examples.zh: 把项目草稿发给研讨小组之前，我们查看了「链接设置」。

examples.en: The link settings appeared in a separate panel on the page for the document.
examples.zh: 文档页面有个单独的面板，里面显示了「链接设置」。

words.enDefinition: A sharing option that makes a file available to whoever has the link.

examples.en: The public handout was marked “Anyone with the link” on the workshop page that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，研讨活动页上的公开讲义标为「获得链接的任何人」都能看。

examples.en: We discussed what “Anyone with the link” meant before choosing how to share our notes.
examples.zh: 决定怎么共享笔记前，我们讨论了「获得链接的任何人」这个选项的含义。

collocations: a setting labeled anyone with the link
accessible to anyone with the link
a label saying anyone with the link

words.zhGloss: 仅授权用户可用的链接
words.enDefinition: A sharing link limited to the recipients or group selected by the person sharing it.
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅授权用户可用的链接

examples.en: The tutor sent a restricted link for the feedback addressed to our project group.
examples.zh: 导师用「仅授权用户可用的链接」发来专门给我们项目组的反馈。

examples.en: My classmate labeled the restricted link so we could distinguish it from the public reading list.
examples.zh: 同学标记了「仅授权用户可用的链接」，让我们能把它和公开阅读清单区分开。

collocations: a restricted link to the folder

words.enDefinition: A category for people who already have permission to open a file or folder.

examples.en: The dialog described “People with existing access” as one option when sharing our group notes.
examples.zh: 共享小组笔记时，对话框把「已有权限的人」列为一个选项。

examples.en: I picked a link for people with existing access because our whole team was already invited.
examples.zh: 我们组已经全员受邀，所以我选了面向「已有权限的人」的链接。

collocations: a link for people with existing access
available to people with existing access

words.enDefinition: The person or account identified as responsible for a file in a service.

examples.en: I asked the file owner whether the project outline was ready for the tutor to read.
examples.zh: 我问「文件所有者」，项目提纲现在能不能给导师看了。

examples.en: The file owner rearranged the folders after we finished collecting the photographs for our report.
examples.zh: 我们把报告要用的照片收集完后，「文件所有者」重新整理了文件夹。

collocations: a message from the file owner

words.enDefinition: Someone invited to access or contribute to a shared file or workspace.

examples.en: The project tutor joined as an invited collaborator to read our draft before class.
examples.zh: 项目导师作为「受邀协作者」加入，在课前阅读我们的草稿。

examples.en: Each invited collaborator had a name beside their role on the sharing panel for our document.
examples.zh: 我们文档的共享面板上，每位「受邀协作者」的姓名旁都显示了相应角色。

collocations: an invited collaborator on a file

words.enDefinition: Permission to see a file without making changes to it.

examples.en: The tutor gave us view-only access to the sample so the original would stay intact.
examples.zh: 导师给了我们示例的「仅查看权限」，这样原文件能保持完整。

examples.en: I could read the slides with view-only access while another classmate worked on the speaker notes.
examples.zh: 我用「仅查看权限」阅读幻灯片，另一位同学在编辑演讲备注。

collocations: open a file with view-only access

words.enDefinition: Permission to read and leave comments on a file without changing its main content.

examples.en: Our tutor gave reviewers comment-only access while two group members edited the project report.
examples.zh: 我们组两名成员在编辑项目报告，辅导老师给了评阅人「可查看和批注的权限」。

examples.en: I had comment-only access, so I left a question beside the table about survey responses.
examples.zh: 我有「可查看和批注的权限」，就把关于问卷答案的问题留在了表格旁边。

collocations: review a draft with comment-only access

words.enDefinition: To review who can open a file and control the roles they have.

examples.en: I opened “Manage access” to check whether our tutor was on the list for the draft.
examples.zh: 我打开「管理访问权限」，检查导师是不是在草稿的共享名单里。

examples.en: The group leader showed me the panel labeled “Manage access” on the project file.
examples.zh: 组长给我看了项目文件中标为「管理访问权限」的面板。

collocations: use manage access to review roles

words.enDefinition: To ask the person responsible for a file or folder for permission to open it.

examples.en: I clicked “Request access” when I couldn't open the worksheet from my seminar group.
examples.zh: 打不开研讨小组的练习表时，我点了「请求访问权限」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to request access before she could read the group's background notes.
examples.zh: 同学需要先「请求访问权限」，才能看小组的背景笔记。

words.enDefinition: A status showing that a request for permission has still to be answered.

examples.en: The screen said “Access request pending” after I asked to read the updated seminar notes.
examples.zh: 我请求读取更新过的研讨课笔记后，屏幕显示「访问请求待处理」。

examples.en: I saw “Access request pending” when I reopened the document during our group meeting.
examples.zh: 小组开会时我重新打开文档，看到了「访问请求待处理」。

collocations: a notice saying access request pending
see access request pending on a file

words.enDefinition: To give someone permission to open a file or shared workspace.

examples.en: Our tutor agreed to grant access to the student who joined our group that week.
examples.zh: 导师同意「授予访问权限」，让那周加入小组的同学也能查看文件。

examples.en: I asked the file owner to grant access to our second reviewer before the workshop.
examples.zh: 研讨活动前，我请文件所有者「授予访问权限」，让第二位评阅人也能查看文件。

words.enDefinition: To take away a person's permission to open or use a shared item.

examples.en: The course facilitator used “Remove access” after the guest review session had ended that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，外部评阅活动结束后，课程负责人使用了「移除访问权限」。

examples.en: The option to remove access appeared beside each collaborator's name in the group project settings.
examples.zh: 小组项目设置里，每位协作者的姓名旁都有「移除访问权限」的选项。

words.enDefinition: To assign a different level of access to someone who already has a sharing role.

examples.en: Our project lead needed to change a sharing role before the tutor could comment on the draft.
examples.zh: 导师要在草稿里评论前，项目负责人需要「更改共享角色」。

examples.en: I asked who could change a sharing role when our teacher wanted to join the folder.
examples.zh: 老师想加入共享文件夹时，我问谁可以「更改共享角色」。

collocations: decide to change a sharing role
be allowed to change a sharing role
ask the owner to change a sharing role

words.enDefinition: To end the sharing arrangements for a particular file.

examples.en: The menu offered “Stop sharing this file” beside the list of people with access.
examples.zh: 菜单在已有权限的人员名单旁提供了「停止共享此文件」。

examples.en: Our group leader discussed when to stop sharing this file after submitting the final report.
examples.zh: 交了最终报告后，组长和大家商量何时「停止共享此文件」。

collocations: a button saying stop sharing this file

words.enDefinition: A link that is set to stop working after a specified time.

examples.en: Our tutor used an expiring link to share the practice files for that week's workshop.
examples.zh: 导师用「会到期的链接」共享那周研讨活动的练习文件。

examples.en: My classmate asked when the expiring link would stop working before opening the course material.
examples.zh: 同学打开课程资料之前，先问了「会到期的链接」什么时候会失效。

words.enDefinition: Sharing materials with people within the same school, team, or organization.

examples.en: The project notes were marked for internal sharing among people in our seminar group.
examples.zh: 项目笔记标为「组织内共享」，只供我们研讨小组成员使用。

examples.en: We discussed internal sharing before deciding where the supervisor could leave feedback on our draft.
examples.zh: 决定导师在哪儿给草稿留反馈前，我们先谈了「组织内共享」。

words.enDefinition: Giving people outside a school, team, or organization access to materials.

examples.en: The coordinator checked whether the folder allowed external sharing with the class's invited guest reviewer.
examples.zh: 课程协调员查看了文件夹能否通过「向组织外共享」让受邀校外评阅人访问。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed external sharing when a mentor from another university joined our final project.
examples.zh: 另一所大学的一位导师加入期末项目时，我们的导师讲了「向组织外共享」。

words.enDefinition: To give people you select access to a file or folder.

examples.en: We chose “Share with specific people” when we sent the draft to two classmates.
examples.zh: 把草稿发给两位同学时，我们选了「与指定人员共享」。

examples.en: The tutorial used “Share with specific people” as its example for a seminar project.
examples.zh: 教程用研讨课项目作例子，介绍了「与指定人员共享」。

collocations: a setting to share with specific people
decide to share with specific people

words.enDefinition: A file service label for items other people have shared with your account.

examples.en: I found the tutor's reading list under “Shared with me” after opening my cloud drive.
examples.zh: 我打开云盘后，在「与我共享」里找到了导师的阅读清单。

examples.en: The folder appeared in “Shared with me” when our group leader finished setting it up.
examples.zh: 组长设置好文件夹后，它就出现在「与我共享」里。

collocations: an item in shared with me

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the name of the person or account that shared an item.

examples.en: I checked the “Shared by” label to see which classmate had sent the reading notes.
examples.zh: 我看了「共享人」一栏，想知道读书笔记是哪位同学发的。

examples.en: The list showed a name next to “Shared by” for each of our project files.
examples.zh: 列表中，我们每个项目文件的「共享人」旁都显示了一个名字。

words.enDefinition: A message saying that the current account does not have access to the item.

examples.en: I got “You need permission” after opening the draft from the wrong account on campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校用错账号打开草稿时，看见了「你需要访问权限」。

examples.en: The screen said “You need permission” when I followed a classmate's link to her folder.
examples.zh: 我点开同学发来的文件夹链接时，屏幕显示「你需要访问权限」。

collocations: a warning saying you need permission
a message reading you need permission
an error labeled you need permission

words.enDefinition: To change who is recorded as the owner of a file or folder.

examples.en: The old project lead agreed to transfer ownership once the new group had been confirmed.
examples.zh: 新小组确定后，原项目负责人同意「转让所有权」。

examples.en: The dialog summarized what it would mean to transfer ownership of our shared reference folder.
examples.zh: 对话框简要说明了，共享参考文件夹一旦「转让所有权」会有哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: Access to an item that comes from permissions on its containing folder or space.

examples.en: The file showed inherited access because it was already inside our seminar's shared folder.
examples.zh: 该文件已经在研讨课的共享文件夹里，所以显示了「继承的访问权限」。

examples.en: The sharing panel marked inherited access beside my name when I checked the folder.
examples.zh: 我检查文件夹时，共享面板在我姓名旁标了「继承的访问权限」。

collocations: review inherited access on a file

words.enDefinition: A message asking someone to join a file as a person who can edit it.

examples.en: I received an invitation to edit after offering to check the captions for our presentation.
examples.zh: 我提出可以校对展示文稿的图片说明之后，收到了「编辑邀请」。

examples.en: My teammate accepted the invitation to edit while we were meeting at the library.
examples.zh: 我们在图书馆碰头时，队友接受了「编辑邀请」。

words.enDefinition: The actions a sharing link allows someone to take, such as viewing or editing.

examples.en: I checked the link permissions before forwarding the handout to the rest of my seminar.
examples.zh: 把讲义转给研讨课其他同学之前，我查看了「共享链接权限」。

examples.en: The link permissions let our reviewers see the draft while they were away from campus.
examples.zh: 凭这条链接的「共享链接权限」，即使不在校园里，评阅人也能看草稿。

words.enDefinition: Access granted to a specific account itself, rather than through a sharing link.

examples.en: The tutor had direct access to our folder after the owner added her account.
examples.zh: 所有者添加导师的账号后，她就有了这个文件夹「直接授予的权限」。

examples.en: I checked which group members had direct access before deciding who still needed an invitation.
examples.zh: 决定还要邀请谁之前，我查了哪些组员已有「直接授予的权限」。

collocations: a list of people with direct access

words.enDefinition: To make changes to the same document together with another person.

examples.en: We can co-edit a document after class while the rest of our group runs the survey.
examples.zh: 下课后我们可以「共同编辑文档」，小组其他成员负责做调查。

examples.en: I learned to co-edit a document with my lab partner during our first research project.
examples.zh: 第一次做研究项目时，我学会了和实验搭档「共同编辑文档」。

collocations: co-edit a document with a partner

words.enDefinition: Editing in which changes become visible to collaborators as they are made.

examples.en: Real-time editing made it easier for us to rearrange the slides during the rehearsal.
examples.zh: 「实时编辑」让我们在排练时更容易调整幻灯片顺序。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated real-time editing by changing a heading while we watched from our laptops.
examples.zh: 辅导老师改了一个标题，让我们在自己的笔记本电脑上观看「实时编辑」的效果。

words.enDefinition: A marker showing another person's current position in a shared document.

examples.en: I saw a collaborator cursor beside the table where my partner was checking the figures.
examples.zh: 我看到表格旁有一个「协作者光标」，搭档正在那里核对数字。

examples.en: The screen showed a collaborator cursor moving through the first paragraph during our group call.
examples.zh: 小组通话时，屏幕上有一个「协作者光标」正在第一段里移动。

words.enDefinition: A document mode in which you can make changes directly to the content.

examples.en: Nina switched to editing mode and fixed the spelling of our guest speaker's name.
examples.zh: 妮娜切换到「编辑模式」，改正了特邀讲者名字的拼写。

examples.en: The demo started in editing mode so everyone could watch me change the section headings.
examples.zh: 演示开始时处于「编辑模式」，所以大家都能看见我修改各节的标题。

words.enDefinition: A display mode you can select to review content without making direct edits.

examples.en: I switched to viewing mode before reading the draft aloud to our study group.
examples.zh: 给学习小组朗读草稿前，我切换到了「查看模式」。

examples.en: The teaching assistant kept the file in viewing mode while checking everyone's references yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天助教核对大家的参考文献时，让文件保持在「查看模式」。

words.enDefinition: To respond to a note by adding a message in the same discussion.

examples.en: I can reply to a comment in the draft instead of starting another email chain.
examples.zh: 我可以直接在草稿里「回复批注」，不用另开一串邮件。

examples.en: Please reply to a comment about the survey if you know where the figures came from.
examples.zh: 如果你知道这些数字的来源，请「回复那条关于调查的批注」。

collocations: reply to a comment in context

words.enDefinition: To make a resolved comment active again so discussion can continue.

examples.en: I had to reopen a comment when the revised graph raised the same question again.
examples.zh: 修改后的图表又引出了同一个问题，我只好「重新开启批注」。

examples.en: Could you reopen a comment about the appendix so we can finish that discussion tonight?
examples.zh: 你能「重新打开关于附录的那条批注」吗？这样我们今晚就能把那件事谈完。

words.enDefinition: To identify a collaborator by name or account tag in a document note or discussion.

examples.en: I used the comment box to mention a collaborator who had the original interview notes.
examples.zh: 我在批注框里「提及了一名协作者」，原始访谈笔记在她手上。

examples.en: When I mention a collaborator in the draft, I usually include the question for them.
examples.zh: 我在草稿中「提及协作者」时，通常会把想问对方的问题写上。

collocations: mention a collaborator in a comment

words.enDefinition: To give a specific person responsibility for following up on a comment.

examples.en: I can assign a comment about the figures to the teammate who collected the raw data.
examples.zh: 收集原始数据的组员可以回答数字方面的问题，我可以「给他指派批注」。

examples.en: Before the rehearsal, I will assign a comment about each missing slide image to its presenter.
examples.zh: 排练前，我会为涉及幻灯片缺图的问题「指派批注」，由对应的主讲同学确认。

collocations: assign a comment to a teammate
assign a comment to its author

words.enDefinition: To propose a change that another person can review before it becomes part of the document.

examples.en: I want to suggest an edit to the introduction before anyone rewrites the whole section.
examples.zh: 在有人重写整节内容前，我想先对引言「提出修改建议」。

examples.en: Could you suggest an edit to that sentence so the reader knows who conducted the interviews?
examples.zh: 你能否对那句话「提出修改建议」，让读者知道访谈是谁做的？

collocations: suggest an edit to a sentence
suggest an edit in the margin

words.enDefinition: To approve a proposed change so it becomes part of a document.

examples.en: I chose to accept a suggestion that made the chart title clearer for our classmates.
examples.zh: 有一条建议能让同学更容易看懂图表标题，我决定「接受这条修订建议」。

examples.en: Before you accept a suggestion, please check that it still matches the values in our table.
examples.zh: 在「接受修订建议」之前，请确认它仍然符合我们表里的数值。

collocations: accept a suggestion from a reviewer

words.enDefinition: To turn down a proposed change and leave it out of the main document.

examples.en: I had to reject a suggestion because it accidentally changed the meaning of the original quotation.
examples.zh: 那条建议无意中改了原引文的意思，我不得不「拒绝这条修订建议」。

examples.en: If you reject a suggestion about my paragraph, could you tell me your reason in a comment?
examples.zh: 如果你对我写的段落「拒绝了一条修订建议」，能在批注里告诉我理由吗？

collocations: reject a suggestion with an explanation
reject a suggestion from a reviewer

words.enDefinition: An alert that someone added, mentioned you in, or replied to a comment.

examples.en: I got a comment notification while I was on the bus home from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆坐公交回家时收到了一条「批注通知」。

examples.en: The comment notification took me straight to my partner's question under the diagram we made.
examples.zh: 这条「批注通知」把我直接带到了搭档在我们那张示意图下提出的问题。

words.enDefinition: An area beside the document where comments and replies can be viewed or managed.

examples.en: I opened the comments pane so I could see all the feedback beside the draft.
examples.zh: 我打开「批注窗格」，这样就能在草稿旁看到所有反馈。

examples.en: The comments pane hid part of our diagram when we shared the file on a small screen.
examples.zh: 我们在小屏幕上展示文件时，「批注窗格」遮住了示意图的一部分。

collocations: read replies in the comments pane

words.enDefinition: A comment that remains open and may still require a reply or action.

examples.en: There was one unresolved comment asking whether we had permission to reproduce the photograph in the handout.
examples.zh: 还有一条「未解决的批注」，问我们是否获准在讲义里复制那张照片。

examples.en: An unresolved comment at the end of the draft reminded me to check the spelling of Lina's name.
examples.zh: 草稿末尾的一条「未解决的批注」提醒我核对莉娜名字的拼写。

words.enDefinition: A period during which someone has a document open for editing.

examples.en: Our editing session lasted until the library closed and someone reminded us to pack up.
examples.zh: 我们「这次编辑」一直持续到图书馆关门，有人提醒我们收拾东西才结束。

examples.en: During my editing session, we decided to move the diagram to the beginning of the report.
examples.zh: 在我「这次编辑」时，我们决定把示意图挪到报告开头。

words.enDefinition: A control that temporarily prevents a file or part of a file from being edited.

examples.en: An editing lock appeared on the worksheet while the project coordinator was updating the grade totals.
examples.zh: 项目协调员更新成绩总分时，工作表上出现了一个「编辑锁」。

examples.en: The notes said the editing lock was temporary and the reading link would still work.
examples.zh: 说明中说「编辑锁」是暂时的，阅读链接仍然有效。

words.enDefinition: A label identifying the person who most recently edited a file.

examples.en: The Last edited by label showed my tutor's name even though I originally created the file.
examples.zh: 虽然文件是我最初创建的，但「上次编辑者」一栏显示的是辅导老师的名字。

examples.en: Look under Last edited by to see who changed the reading notes after the workshop.
examples.zh: 查看「上次编辑者」一栏，就能知道工作坊结束后是谁改了阅读笔记。

collocations: check the last edited by field

words.enDefinition: To display a file or linked item in a web browser instead of a separate app.

examples.en: I chose Open in browser because I was working at a public computer in the library.
examples.zh: 因为当时用的是图书馆的公共电脑，我选择了「在浏览器中打开」。

examples.en: Open in browser was the option our tutor used when checking our slides from her laptop.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在笔记本电脑上查看我们的幻灯片时用的是「在浏览器中打开」选项。

collocations: open in browser from the menu
open a document in the browser

words.enDefinition: To display a cloud file in the installed desktop application associated with it.

examples.en: I selected Open in desktop app so I could see the spreadsheet on my larger screen.
examples.zh: 我选择了「在桌面应用中打开」，这样就能在大屏幕上看电子表格。

examples.en: The class handout showed an Open in desktop app option beside the spreadsheet on the portal.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义展示了门户中电子表格旁的「在桌面应用中打开」选项。

collocations: open a file in the desktop app
the open in desktop app option

words.enDefinition: The place in a file to which a comment is attached.

examples.en: The comment anchor pointed to the number in the caption instead of the number in the table.
examples.zh: 「批注锚点」指向的是图注里的数字，不是表格里的数字。

examples.en: I could not find the comment anchor after our group removed the paragraph it belonged to.
examples.zh: 小组删掉对应的段落后，我找不到「批注锚点」了。

words.enDefinition: A collaborator currently present in a shared file or workspace.

examples.en: The document showed one active collaborator when I logged in to review the conclusion after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我登录查看结论时，文档显示有一位「在线协作者」。

examples.en: I saw an active collaborator on the group whiteboard even though everyone had left the study room.
examples.zh: 虽然大家都离开自习室了，我仍看到小组白板上有一位「在线协作者」。

words.enDefinition: A display layout that presents files in rows, often with columns for file details.

examples.en: I switched to list view so I could compare the sizes of our classmates' videos.
examples.zh: 我切换到「列表视图」，这样就能比较同学们上传的视频大小。

examples.en: The tutor used list view to show which of the workshop files had changed since Tuesday.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「列表视图」展示了哪些工作坊文件在周二以后有修改。

collocations: open a folder in list view

words.enDefinition: To write your observations or suggestions directly in the file being reviewed.

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to leave feedback in the document before the next writing workshop started.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们在下一场写作工作坊开始前「在文档里留反馈」。

examples.en: If the dates look wrong, please leave feedback in the document while you have it open.
examples.zh: 如果日期看起来有问题，请趁文件开着时「在文档里留反馈」。

collocations: leave feedback in the document itself
leave feedback in the shared document
leave brief feedback in the document

words.enDefinition: Information about actions that people have taken on a document.

examples.en: The document activity helped me check whether the diagram was added before or after our meeting.
examples.zh: 我通过「文档活动记录」查看示意图是在开会之前还是之后添加的。

examples.en: Our project lead checked document activity after noticing that two sections had moved overnight.
examples.zh: 项目组长发现有两节内容在夜里换了位置，就查看了「文档活动记录」。

words.enDefinition: To have a shared canvas or whiteboard show the area another participant is viewing.

examples.en: I chose to follow a collaborator while she walked us through the survey map on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 队友在白板上讲解调查地图时，我选择了「跟随协作者视图」。

examples.en: You can follow a collaborator during the demo so everyone sees the same part of the board.
examples.zh: 演示时可以「跟随协作者视图」，这样大家看到的是白板的同一区域。

collocations: follow a collaborator on the board

words.enDefinition: A viewer whose name is not shown to others in a shared file.

examples.en: An anonymous viewer appeared just after I sent the group the link to our reading list.
examples.zh: 我刚把阅读清单的链接发给小组，就出现了一位「匿名查看者」。

examples.en: The class demo showed how an anonymous viewer might be represented by an icon instead of a name.
examples.zh: 课堂演示给我们看了「匿名查看者」如何用图标代替姓名显示。

words.enDefinition: A state of a file from before its most recent changes.

examples.en: The previous version still had the notes we took before shortening the introduction last week.
examples.zh: 「早期版本」还保留着我们上周缩短引言前记下的笔记。

examples.en: I found a previous version with all the figures from our original library survey intact.
examples.zh: 我找到一个「早期版本」，里面完整保留了我们最初做图书馆调查时的数据。

words.enDefinition: To make an earlier state of a file its current version again.

examples.en: Our group decided to restore a previous version after we discovered a missing source table.
examples.zh: 发现少了一张列出资料来源的表格后，我们小组决定「恢复旧版本」。

examples.en: I asked whether we should restore a previous version before changing the introduction a second time.
examples.zh: 我问是否应该先「恢复旧版本」，再第二次修改引言。

collocations: restore a previous version from history
restore a previous version of a document
choose to restore a previous version

words.enDefinition: To examine two or more states of a file to see what changed.

examples.en: We tried to compare versions of the report before deciding which data table to keep.
examples.zh: 决定保留哪张数据表之前，我们先试着「比较报告的不同版本」。

examples.en: Could you compare versions and check when the final paragraph lost its opening sentence yesterday?
examples.zh: 你能「比较不同版本」，看看末段开头那句话是昨天什么时候丢掉的吗？

words.enDefinition: A saved version with a descriptive name that helps people recognize it later.

examples.en: Our final rehearsal had a named version so we could find it again before presenting.
examples.zh: 我们为最后一次排练保存了一个「已命名版本」，方便在正式展示前找回来。

examples.en: I opened a named version labeled Workshop Draft to check a suggestion from last month's class.
examples.zh: 我打开一个标签为 Workshop Draft 的「已命名版本」，核对上个月课堂上收到的建议。

words.enDefinition: To save both files when a copy operation or conflict could otherwise replace one of them.

examples.en: The app offered to keep both copies when I added the slides with the same name.
examples.zh: 我添加同名幻灯片时，应用提供了「保留两份副本」的选项。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to keep both copies so the groups could compare their answers later.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们「保留两份副本」，好让各组以后比较答案。

collocations: keep both copies of a file

words.enDefinition: To save new data over the current contents of a file.

examples.en: I did not want to overwrite a file that still held another group's original interview notes.
examples.zh: 我不想「覆盖这份文件」，因为里面还有另一小组的原始访谈笔记。

examples.en: The warning appeared when I tried to overwrite a file with my corrected lab table.
examples.zh: 我尝试用改好的实验表格「覆盖文件」时，屏幕上出现了警告。

collocations: overwrite a file with a newer copy
overwrite a file of the same name

words.enDefinition: To create a new file with the same contents as the original.

examples.en: Our lecturer asked everyone to make a copy of the worksheet before entering their own answers.
examples.zh: 讲师请大家先为工作表「创建副本」，再在里面填写自己的答案。

examples.en: Can we make a copy for the practice session and keep the presentation file as it is?
examples.zh: 我们能「创建副本」来排练，让正式演示文件保持原样吗？

collocations: make a copy of a template

words.enDefinition: An extra file that has the same content as another file.

examples.en: I found a duplicate file while checking which readings we already had in the class folder.
examples.zh: 我在检查班级文件夹里有哪些阅读材料时，发现了一个「重复文件」。

examples.en: The search results included a duplicate file with the same diagram under a slightly different name.
examples.zh: 搜索结果里有一个「重复文件」，名字略有不同，但里面是同一张示意图。

words.enDefinition: An extra copy created when a service cannot reconcile different changes to the same file.

examples.en: A conflicted copy appeared after two people edited the reading list while they were offline.
examples.zh: 两个人在离线时都修改了阅读清单，之后出现了一个「冲突副本」。

examples.en: We opened the conflicted copy to see which references were missing from the current list.
examples.zh: 我们打开「冲突副本」，看看当前清单里少了哪些参考文献。

words.enDefinition: To bring edits from separate copies or versions together into one file.

examples.en: Our partners had edited separate copies, so we met to merge changes before submitting the report.
examples.zh: 搭档们分别改了不同副本，所以我们见面「合并修改」后再提交报告。

examples.en: We could merge changes to the bibliography because our two groups had checked different sources.
examples.zh: 两组核对的是不同的资料来源，因此我们可以把参考文献的「修改合并」。

collocations: merge changes into the main draft

words.enDefinition: A label showing when the file was most recently saved.

examples.en: I checked the Last saved time before sending the updated orientation schedule to our project group.
examples.zh: 我先查看「最近保存时间」，然后把更新过的迎新活动日程发给项目小组。

examples.en: The Last saved label showed midnight, which matched when my roommate finished editing the document.
examples.zh: 「最近保存时间」显示为午夜，和我室友完成文档编辑的时间吻合。

words.enDefinition: A status message confirming the application has saved the changes made so far.

examples.en: The All changes saved message appeared before I closed the document and left the study room.
examples.zh: 我关掉文档离开自习室之前，屏幕上出现了「所有修改已保存」的提示。

examples.en: Once I saw All changes saved, I told the group the corrected handout was ready.
examples.zh: 看到「所有修改已保存」后，我就告诉小组修改好的讲义可以用了。

words.enDefinition: To retain the unchanged source file when making or editing another file.

examples.en: Please keep the original so we can compare the transcript with our edited practice script.
examples.zh: 请「保留原件」，这样我们可以把文字记录和改过的练习稿对照着看。

examples.en: We wanted to keep the original when we made a smaller copy of the campus map.
examples.zh: 我们把校园地图复制并缩小了一份，同时想「保留原件」。

collocations: keep the original in a separate folder

words.enDefinition: To return a deleted item from a service's trash to the files you can use.

examples.en: Our tutor chose Restore from trash when the sample data disappeared from the workshop folder.
examples.zh: 示例数据从工作坊文件夹消失后，辅导老师选择了「从回收站恢复」。

examples.en: The Restore from trash option was available for the worksheet we misplaced during the class demo.
examples.zh: 课堂演示时弄丢的那份工作表还有「从回收站恢复」选项。

collocations: restore from trash in the file menu

words.enDefinition: To put a file in the place where a service holds deleted items.

examples.en: I saw Move to trash beside the old handout when I opened its file menu.
examples.zh: 我打开旧讲义的文件菜单时，在旁边看到了「移到回收站」。

examples.en: I checked which worksheet was mine before selecting Move to trash for the extra copy.
examples.zh: 我先确认哪张工作表是我的，才给多出来的一份选择「移到回收站」。

collocations: see the move to trash option

words.enDefinition: The place in some systems where deleted items are held before final removal.

examples.en: The file was still in the recycle bin when I noticed it missing from our folder.
examples.zh: 我发现文件在我们文件夹里不见了时，它还在「回收站」。

examples.en: My classmate looked in the recycle bin for a spreadsheet she had deleted earlier that morning.
examples.zh: 同学在「回收站」里找当天早些时候删掉的电子表格。

collocations: find a document in the recycle bin

words.enDefinition: To remove an item without leaving an ordinary option to restore it from the trash.

examples.en: I read the Permanently delete warning and asked our group which version they wanted to retain.
examples.zh: 我看到「永久删除」警告后，问了小组成员希望留哪个版本。

examples.en: The example screen showed Permanently delete near the bottom of the menu for an old draft.
examples.zh: 示例界面中，旧草稿菜单靠下的位置显示着「永久删除」。

collocations: a warning about permanently deleting files

words.enDefinition: A stored date and time that identifies when an edit was made.

examples.en: The edit timestamp helped us match the revised title to the notes from our group call.
examples.zh: 「编辑时间戳」帮助我们将修订后的标题与小组通话记录对照起来。

examples.en: I noted the edit timestamp next to the figures so my tutor could find the revision later.
examples.zh: 我记下数字旁的「编辑时间戳」，方便辅导老师之后找到这次修改。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a revision of a file or document.

examples.en: The revision number on the diagram helped us identify which version the workshop leader had printed.
examples.zh: 图上的「修订编号」让我们知道工作坊负责人打印的是哪个版本。

examples.en: Our tutor wrote the revision number on the feedback form so we could find the right document.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在反馈表上写了「修订编号」，方便我们找到对应的文档。

words.enDefinition: A copy kept or created to recover data when a working file becomes unavailable.

examples.en: I found a recovery copy of the field notes after the laptop closed during our lab.
examples.zh: 实验课上笔记本电脑关机后，我找到了现场笔记的「恢复副本」。

examples.en: The recovery copy contained the table we thought had disappeared before the last workshop ended.
examples.zh: 「恢复副本」里有那张表格，我们原以为它在上次工作坊结束前就丢了。

words.enDefinition: A file state that permits viewing and prevents changes to that copy.

examples.en: The sample contract opened in read-only mode when I checked it during our group workshop.
examples.zh: 我们小组做工作坊练习时，我打开样本合同查看，文件进入了「只读模式」。

examples.en: I left the minutes in read-only mode while checking the spelling of the speakers' names.
examples.zh: 我核对发言者姓名的拼写时，让会议记录保持在「只读模式」。

words.enDefinition: The folder that directly contains a given folder.

examples.en: I went back to the parent folder to find our other worksheets from the spring workshop.
examples.zh: 我返回「上一级文件夹」，去找春季工作坊的其他工作表。

examples.en: The parent folder held three smaller folders named after the weeks in our group research schedule.
examples.zh: 「上一级文件夹」里有三个小文件夹，以小组研究日程中的周次命名。

words.enDefinition: A folder contained inside another folder.

examples.en: Each project group had a subfolder for sample photographs inside the shared class folder online.
examples.zh: 班级共享云文件夹中，每个项目小组都有一个用来存示例照片的「子文件夹」。

examples.en: I created a subfolder for slides so our notes and handouts were easy to find.
examples.zh: 我建了一个放幻灯片的「子文件夹」，这样笔记和讲义也更好找。

words.enDefinition: To change a file's name while keeping it as the same file.

examples.en: Our tutor asked me to rename a file so its title would include our workshop date.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我「重命名文件」，好让标题能包含工作坊的日期。

examples.en: Do I need to rename a file if our group decides to change its presentation title?
examples.zh: 如果小组决定改演示标题，我需要「重命名文件」吗？

collocations: rename a file in the folder

words.enDefinition: To add a version number at the end of a file name or label.

examples.en: We append a version number when we save marked copies of the diagrams for our supervisor.
examples.zh: 每次保存示意图副本供导师查看时，我们会「在末尾加版本号」。

examples.en: I asked whether to append a version number to every draft in the workshop folder.
examples.zh: 我问工作坊文件夹里的每份草稿文件名是否都要「在末尾加版本号」。

collocations: append a version number to the file name
append a version number to the title

words.enDefinition: A file copy used to make changes or do current work.

examples.en: I kept a working copy of the poster so the original could stay in our archive.
examples.zh: 我保留了一份海报的「编辑用副本」，让原件继续放在归档区。

examples.en: Could I use your working copy for tomorrow's session if you have already added the diagrams?
examples.zh: 如果你已经加上示意图，明天的讨论可以用你的「编辑用副本」吗？

collocations: share a working copy with reviewers

words.enDefinition: to return to the first form of something that was changed, such as its wording or design

examples.en: I suggested we go back to the original after everyone agreed that the first layout was clearer.
examples.zh: 大家都认为初版布局更清楚后，我提议把布局「改回最初的样子」。

examples.en: Can we go back to the original for the heading and leave the rest of the page unchanged?
examples.zh: 标题能「改回最初的样子」，页面其他内容照旧吗？

collocations: go back to the original wording
go back to the original design
decide to go back to the original

words.enDefinition: To change a file's location in the folders of a device or cloud service.

examples.en: I needed to move a file into our archive once the revised drawing was ready to share.
examples.zh: 改好的图纸可以分享后，我需要把一份「文件移动」到我们的归档区。

examples.en: Please let the group know before you move a file that we use in our weekly workshop.
examples.zh: 如果要移动我们每周工作坊用到的文件，请在「移动文件」前告诉小组。

collocations: move a file into an archive
move a file to a shared location

words.enDefinition: An indication of whether files are up to date, waiting, or having trouble syncing.

examples.en: I checked the sync status before asking my project partner to open the revised worksheet.
examples.zh: 我先看了「同步状态」，再请项目搭档打开修改过的工作表。

examples.en: The sync status beside our report helped explain why I was seeing yesterday's table instead.
examples.zh: 报告旁的「同步状态」让我明白自己为什么看到的还是昨天的表格。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a file or change is waiting to be synchronized.

examples.en: The folder showed Sync pending when I reopened my notes on the bus after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我在公交车上重新打开笔记，文件夹显示「等待同步」。

examples.en: My laptop displayed Sync pending beside the photos I had added during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我在实地考察时添加的照片旁，笔记本电脑显示「等待同步」。

collocations: show sync pending beside a file

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that synchronization has been temporarily stopped.

examples.en: The Sync paused notice was still visible when I returned to the library after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我回到图书馆时，「同步已暂停」的提示还在显示。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the Sync paused message while showing us the sample folder online.
examples.zh: 辅导老师给我们展示示例云文件夹时，特意指出了「同步已暂停」的提示。

words.enDefinition: A situation in which a service cannot automatically combine inconsistent changes to the same file.

examples.en: We saw a sync conflict when the field notes and their cloud version contained different edits.
examples.zh: 现场记录和对应的云端版本各有不同修改，我们看到了「同步冲突」。

examples.en: I reported a sync conflict after my partner and I both updated the same spreadsheet offline.
examples.zh: 搭档和我离线更新了同一份电子表格，我报告了这次「同步冲突」。

words.enDefinition: To update another storage location or device with file edits so both show matching contents.

examples.en: The app began to sync changes as soon as my tablet reconnected to the campus network.
examples.zh: 我的平板一重新连上校园网，应用就开始「同步修改」。

examples.en: I left the notes from our afternoon workshop open while the program tried to sync changes.
examples.zh: 应用尝试「同步修改」时，我让下午工作坊用过的笔记保持打开。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a file stored on the device you are using rather than solely online.

examples.en: I kept a local copy of the handout for the bus ride to our field site.
examples.zh: 坐公交去实地考察地点前，我留了一份讲义的「本地副本」。

examples.en: The local copy on my laptop was older than the copy my classmates opened online.
examples.zh: 我笔记本电脑上的「本地副本」比同学在线打开的那一份旧。

words.enDefinition: A file listed on the device that normally needs an internet connection to open.

examples.en: The campus map was an online-only file, so it would not open without internet access on the train.
examples.zh: 校园地图是「仅在线可用的文件」，所以我在火车上断网时打不开。

examples.en: I recognized the online-only file by the cloud symbol beside it in our shared folder.
examples.zh: 我看共享文件夹里文件旁边的云朵标记，认出了那个「仅在线可用的文件」。

words.enDefinition: Accessible on your device without an internet connection.

examples.en: My project notes were available offline when the campus network went down during our presentation.
examples.zh: 演示时校园网断了，但我的项目笔记仍「可离线访问」。

examples.en: We checked whether the bus timetable was available offline before leaving for the field trip.
examples.zh: 出发去实地考察前，我们查看了公交时刻表是否「可离线访问」。

words.enDefinition: To retain a local copy of a cloud file so it can be opened offline.

examples.en: I chose Keep on this device so the reading would be available during my train ride.
examples.zh: 我选择了「保留在此设备上」，这样坐火车时也能看阅读材料。

examples.en: The project brief showed a Keep on this device option beside the campus map in our folder.
examples.zh: 项目说明展示了文件夹中校园地图旁的「保留在此设备上」选项。

collocations: the keep on this device option
mark a file to keep on this device

words.enDefinition: A designated folder whose contents a service keeps matched with another location.

examples.en: I saved the slides in my sync folder so I could check them on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我把幻灯片放进「同步文件夹」，好在平板上查看。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to a sync folder while explaining where each group should keep its drafts.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释各小组该把草稿放在哪时，指给我们看了一个「同步文件夹」。

collocations: save files in a sync folder

words.enDefinition: Edits made while a device is not connected to the online copy of a file.

examples.en: My offline changes appeared beside my partner's notes when the document reconnected after our train ride.
examples.zh: 下火车后文档重新联网，我的「离线修改」出现在搭档的笔记旁。

examples.en: We checked the offline changes before merging our two sets of field notes into one report.
examples.zh: 把两份现场笔记合进同一份报告前，我们检查了「离线修改」。

words.enDefinition: To send a folder and its contents to an online service in one operation.

examples.en: Our class assistant helped us upload a folder containing the diagrams from the architecture workshop.
examples.zh: 班级助手帮我们「上传了文件夹」，里面有建筑工作坊用过的示意图。

examples.en: Can I upload a folder with separate copies of the slides for each presenter to review?
examples.zh: 我能「上传一个文件夹」吗？里面放各位展示者供自己审阅的幻灯片副本。

collocations: upload a folder to the drive
upload a folder from your computer

words.enDefinition: An upload of a group of files together rather than one at a time.

examples.en: The batch upload included all the photographs we had cleared for use in the class project.
examples.zh: 这次「批量上传」包含了课程项目获准使用的所有照片。

examples.en: I checked the file list after the batch upload to make sure our charts were included.
examples.zh: 「批量上传」后，我看了文件列表，确认已经包含我们的图表。

words.enDefinition: The list of files waiting for their turn to be uploaded.

examples.en: The upload queue still held two videos when our group finished rehearsing in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们小组在教室排练结束时，「上传队列」里还有两个视频。

examples.en: I added the handout to the upload queue after checking that the latest chart was included.
examples.zh: 我确认已放入最新图表后，把讲义加入了「上传队列」。

collocations: add files to the upload queue

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that an upload has stopped temporarily before completing.

examples.en: The Upload paused notice appeared while I was switching from my home network to the hotspot.
examples.zh: 我从家里网络切换到热点时，屏幕上出现了「上传已暂停」的提示。

examples.en: I saw Upload paused beside the rehearsal video and told my group it might arrive later.
examples.zh: 我看到排练视频旁显示「上传已暂停」，便告诉小组视频可能晚些才会传好。

words.enDefinition: To attempt the same upload again after it did not complete successfully.

examples.en: I chose to retry the upload once the connection recovered and showed my partner the result.
examples.zh: 网络恢复后，我选择了「重试上传」，并把结果给搭档看了。

examples.en: The portal asked me to retry the upload because the draft had not reached our group folder.
examples.zh: 草稿没有传到小组文件夹，门户提示我「重试上传」。

collocations: retry the upload once the connection returns

words.enDefinition: To continue an upload that was interrupted or paused.

examples.en: I was able to resume the upload when my laptop reconnected to Wi-Fi in the library.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑在图书馆重新连上 Wi-Fi 后，我得以「继续上传」。

examples.en: The student handbook showed a button to resume the upload of an interrupted recording in the demo.
examples.zh: 学生手册用演示说明了如何用按钮「继续上传」中断的录音。

collocations: resume the upload after a pause

words.enDefinition: To stop sending the selected file or files before the upload finishes.

examples.en: I chose Cancel upload after noticing that I had selected the practice recording by mistake.
examples.zh: 发现自己误选了练习用的录音后，我选择了「取消上传」。

examples.en: The Cancel upload button was visible beside the video while our group checked the other files.
examples.zh: 我们小组查看其他文件时，视频旁仍显示「取消上传」按钮。

words.zhGloss: 以 ZIP 压缩包下载
words.enDefinition: To download one or more files packaged as a ZIP archive.
acceptedZhAnswers: 以 ZIP 压缩包下载

examples.en: Our class materials were available to download as a ZIP containing all three practice worksheets.
examples.zh: 课程材料可以「以 ZIP 压缩包下载」，里面有三份练习工作表。

examples.en: I chose Download as a ZIP so I could take the reference images home together.
examples.zh: 我选择了「以 ZIP 压缩包下载」，这样就能把参考图片一起带回家。

collocations: the download as a ZIP option

words.enDefinition: To store a file on the phone, tablet, or computer you are using.

examples.en: The Save to device option let me keep the diagram on my phone for class.
examples.zh: 我用「保存到设备」把示意图保存在手机上课用。

examples.en: I tapped Save to device after finding the updated reading list in our class folder.
examples.zh: 在班级文件夹找到更新后的阅读清单后，我点了「保存到设备」。

words.enDefinition: The directory or place on a device where a downloaded file is saved.

examples.en: I checked the download location because the worksheet was not on my desktop as expected.
examples.zh: 工作表没有像预想的那样出现在桌面上，我去查看了「下载位置」。

examples.en: The lab computer used a different download location from the one I use on my laptop.
examples.zh: 实验室电脑的「下载位置」和我笔记本电脑上用的不同。

words.enDefinition: A status message indicating that the file transfer to your device has finished.

examples.en: The Download complete notification appeared just before I unplugged my laptop in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我在教室拔掉笔记本电脑电源前，刚好看到了「下载已完成」的通知。

examples.en: I saw Download complete after saving the spreadsheet we needed for our afternoon group exercise.
examples.zh: 保存下午小组练习要用的电子表格时，我看到了「下载已完成」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount of cloud storage available to a user, group, or account.

examples.en: Our class project folder reached its cloud storage quota after we added the rehearsal recordings.
examples.zh: 加入排练录像后，课程项目文件夹达到了「云存储配额」上限。

examples.en: The workshop coordinator explained the cloud storage quota before assigning each team a shared folder.
examples.zh: 工作坊协调员在给各组分配共享文件夹前解释了「云存储配额」。

words.enDefinition: The ordered list of folder names that identifies where a folder is located.

examples.en: I sent the folder path to my lab partner because we had two folders named Results.
examples.zh: 因为我们有两个都叫 Results 的文件夹，所以我把「文件夹路径」发给了实验搭档。

examples.en: The folder path showed that the sample images were inside a different week's lesson folder.
examples.zh: 「文件夹路径」显示示例图片在另一周的课程文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: A window or interface for choosing a file to open, add, or upload.

examples.en: The file picker opened in my Downloads folder when I tried to add the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我试着添加工作表时，「文件选择器」打开了我的下载文件夹。

examples.en: I selected both images in the file picker and checked their names before the upload started.
examples.zh: 我在「文件选择器」里选了两张图，在上传开始前确认了它们的名称。

collocations: choose a file in the file picker
select multiple files in the file picker

words.enDefinition: A small image showing a preview or pictorial representation of a file.

examples.en: I recognized our poster by its file thumbnail even though the name had been shortened.
examples.zh: 虽然文件名缩短了，我还是通过「文件缩略图」认出了我们的海报。

examples.en: The file thumbnail made it easier to pick the illustrated handout among the other reading files.
examples.zh: 「文件缩略图」让我更容易从一堆阅读材料里找出带图的讲义。

words.enDefinition: A visual display of a set of folders and the folders nested inside them.

examples.en: I expanded the folder tree to find the files our tutor added under Week Three.
examples.zh: 我展开「文件夹树」，找辅导老师放在 Week Three 下的文件。

examples.en: The folder tree helped us see where the research notes were stored alongside the transcripts.
examples.zh: 「文件夹树」帮我们看出来，研究笔记和访谈文字稿存在一起。

words.enDefinition: To order files according to when they were last changed.

examples.en: I used Sort by date modified to find the diagram our group finished after lunch today.
examples.zh: 我用「按修改日期排序」找到小组今天午饭后完成的示意图。

examples.en: Can you sort by date modified to see which files changed after our last workshop?
examples.zh: 你能「按修改日期排序」，看看上次工作坊后改了哪些文件吗？

collocations: the sort by date modified setting
sort by date modified in descending order

words.enDefinition: An issue that prevents a service from keeping a file up to date across locations.

examples.en: The sync error explained why the graph on my tablet still showed the old survey results.
examples.zh: 「同步错误」说明了我平板上的图为什么仍显示旧的调查结果。

examples.en: I reported a sync error when the cloud folder stopped showing my latest notes from class.
examples.zh: 云文件夹不再显示我最新的课堂笔记后，我报告了一个「同步错误」。

words.enDefinition: To put a URL for a file or page on the clipboard for pasting elsewhere.

examples.en: I chose Copy link so I could put the worksheet in our group chat before class.
examples.zh: 我选择了「复制链接」，好在上课前把工作表的链接发到小组群里。

examples.en: The tutor used Copy link and pasted the address beside the sample reading in our notes.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用了「复制链接」，然后把地址粘贴到笔记里示例阅读材料旁。

words.enDefinition: To add a new pointer that opens an existing file or folder without copying its contents.

examples.en: I wanted to create a shortcut to our seminar folder so its location would stay the same.
examples.zh: 我想「创建快捷方式」来访问研讨课文件夹，让它待在原来的位置。

examples.en: Can we create a shortcut in the class directory for the map we use each week?
examples.zh: 我们每周都会用到这张地图，可以在课程目录里给它「创建快捷方式」吗？

collocations: create a shortcut to a file
create a shortcut in a folder

words.enDefinition: To save an updated form of an existing file as a new version of that file.

examples.en: Our project leader decided to save a new version when we corrected the mislabeled axes.
examples.zh: 我们改正坐标轴标签后，项目组长决定「保存为新版本」。

examples.en: Please save a new version of the poster before sending us a link to review it.
examples.zh: 发链接给我们审阅前，请先把海报「保存为新版本」。

collocations: save a new version after editing
save a new version of the document

words.enDefinition: To look for items using a search limited to the contents of a particular folder.

examples.en: I wanted to search within a folder because every workshop had its own copy of the handout.
examples.zh: 每个工作坊都有自己的讲义副本，所以我想「在指定文件夹内搜索」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed us how to search within a folder for the current reading schedule.
examples.zh: 辅导老师向我们演示了如何「在指定文件夹内搜索」当前的阅读安排。

collocations: search within a folder by name

words.enDefinition: To transfer more than one selected file to a device in a single operation.

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to download multiple files for the workshop before their shared links expired.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们趁共享链接过期前「下载多个文件」，供工作坊使用。

examples.en: I needed to download multiple files so I could mark the five practice worksheets at home.
examples.zh: 我需要「下载多个文件」，好回家批改五份练习作业。

collocations: download multiple files from a folder

words.enDefinition: To mark several files at the same time so an action can be applied to them together.

examples.en: Can you select multiple files before moving the field recordings into the folder for our report?
examples.zh: 你能先「选中多个文件」，再把实地录音移到存放报告的文件夹里吗？

examples.en: I tried to select multiple files after our tutor asked me to collect everyone's diagrams.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我收集大家的示意图后，我试着「选中多个文件」。

collocations: select multiple files in the list
an option to select multiple files

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a download stopped unexpectedly before all the data reached the device.

examples.en: I saw Download interrupted beside the class video when my laptop briefly lost its connection.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本电脑短暂断网时，我看到课程视频旁显示「下载已中断」。

examples.en: The Download interrupted message appeared just before the library closed, so I left the file for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 图书馆快关门时出现了「下载已中断」的提示，所以我打算明天再处理这个文件。

collocations: see download interrupted beside a file

words.enDefinition: The amount of a storage allowance currently occupied by files or other data.

examples.en: I checked the space used after our seminar uploaded three videos to the class drive.
examples.zh: 研讨小组往班级云盘传了三个视频后，我查了一下「已用存储空间」。

examples.en: The space used on our class drive went up after we added the full rehearsal recordings.
examples.zh: 我们上传完整的排练录像后，班级云盘的「已用存储空间」增加了。

collocations: calculate the space used by a folder

words.enDefinition: Information about a file such as its location, size, owner, or modification date.

examples.en: I opened the file details to check whether the survey spreadsheet belonged to our group.
examples.zh: 我打开「文件详细信息」，查问卷电子表格是否属于我们小组。

examples.en: The file details showed that the diagram had been moved into our folder after Tuesday's class.
examples.zh: 「文件详细信息」显示，周二下课后，那张示意图被移入了我们的文件夹。

collocations: view file details in a side panel

words.enDefinition: To display comments that had been marked as finished during an earlier review.

examples.en: I needed to show resolved comments to check why our tutor asked us to move the table.
examples.zh: 我需要「显示已解决的批注」，才能查看辅导老师为什么让我们挪动表格。

examples.en: Can you show resolved comments so we can revisit the questions we answered at the first meeting?
examples.zh: 你能「显示已解决的批注」吗？我们想回顾第一次会议上答过的问题。

collocations: show resolved comments in the pane
a setting to show resolved comments
